extra_quotes: The experiments in this work are performed on an opto-electronic measurement-feedback CIM, schematically shown in Fig. 1.
The finalized Ising model is embedded into the NCIM = 50 256 spins of the CIM by placing as many independent copies as possible on the diagonal of the hardware coupling matrix.
The coupling coefficients Jij ∈ R are programmable as 8-bit signed integers with the range R := {−127, −126, . . . , 0, . . . , 126, 127} ⊂ Z.
